_comment: DECLARED console seams — routes a hand-written typed client under web/src/features/*/api.ts calls and the engine deliberately does NOT mount. Enforced by TestEveryConsoleClientCallHitsARegisteredRoute (cmd/olivares/consoleroutes_test.go). Every entry needs a REASON and an OWNER: a bare allow-list is how the next silent 404 gets in. An entry whose route becomes mounted, or that no client calls any more, FAILS the test until it is deleted.
